note: Rolette County's Lions Park on the east shore of Lake Upsilon, about 7 miles northwest of St. John: a half-moon of back-in sites around a lawn by the road, with a restroom, swimming and fishing. --Claude
summary: County parks page read: 12 electric hookups, picnic tables, restroom, swimming/fishing; nothing on fees, season or reservations. Sites written (manual). Lakeview stands; pin ok. Not on the HHS licensed list.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview stands. On Esri imagery the ~12 back-in spurs fan around a semicircular loop; the outer pad ends are ~20-25 m (north spurs) to ~27-30 m (west spurs) from the water through a continuous band of trees and brush at ~48.9706,-99.8313 and ~48.9703,-99.8316. No pad has an open apron to the shore. Site numbers are not published.
PIN: stored 48.97027,-99.83053 is on the lawn island inside the loop, ~10 m from Google's point: ok.

HOOKUPS: the county gives '12 electrical hookups' without amperage; electric not written. Fees, season and booking are not on the county page - stored derived booking (FCFS always) and potable_water left as they are.

PHONE: stored (701) 477-3149 does not appear on the county page or Google; the county office line on the page is 701-477-5665. Suggest (701) 477-3149 -> 701-477-5665 unless the stored number is known to be the park's.
LICENSING: not on the HHS licensed RV park list (07.17.2025) - existence rests on the county page and imagery (pads and loop clearly built).
GAME AND FISH: the county page only links ND Game and Fish fishing maps; no G&F camping rule applies to a county park.
